articles.title: Postgame RAV4: Flyers Blanked by Pens in Opener
Canes Announce Additional Affiliates For 'Saturday Night Hockey' Package

away.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers are coming off a 7-0 loss to the Pittsburgh Penguins and are looking to improve their performance. Joseph Woll is confirmed to start in goal, and the team is expected to make adjustments to their play, especially in puck possession and pace. David Jiricek is returning to the lineup after being scratched in the first two games.

home.summary: The Carolina Hurricanes are on the back end of consecutive game days and are looking to bounce back from a 5-2 loss to the Washington Capitals. Pyotr Kochetkov is confirmed to start in goal, and the team is expected to focus on improving their puck possession and playing with pace. Brandon Bussi is expected to be scratched in favor of Kochetkov.
